register.labelZh: COME OFF 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: COME OFF Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: come off 可以幫助你詢問蓋、保護套、層板或其他部分能否拆下來。；come off 可以描述鈕扣、標籤、把手、油漆或小部件從某物上脫落。；come off sleeping pills 或 come off painkillers 可以表示逐步停止服用某種藥物,過程通常需要醫護人員協助。；句子中的其他資料能幫助你判斷某物是可以拆下、已經脫落,還是某人正在停止服用某種藥物。
register.summaryEn: Come off helps you ask whether a lid, cover, shelf or other part can be taken away. Come off can describe buttons, labels, handles, paint and small pieces separating from something. Come off sleeping pills or come off painkillers can describe stopping a medicine, often little by little and with medical help. The surrounding words show whether something can be removed, has become detached or is a medicine that somebody is stopping.

contextsEn: Ask whether a part can be removed

register.formalZh: Can 或 does something come off? 表示詢問某物能否拆下來。這個蓋可以拆下來嗎?
register.formalEn: Can or does something come off? asks whether it can be removed. Can this lid come off?

fixedVariable.fixedZh: Can 或 does something come off? 表示詢問某物能否拆下來。這個蓋可以拆下來嗎?
fixedVariable.fixedEn: Can or does something come off? asks whether it can be removed. Can this lid come off?
fixedVariable.variableZh: Something came off 表示某物真的脫落了。鈕扣從我的外套上脫落了。；Come off 後面接藥物名稱時,可以表示停止服用該藥物,過程通常循序漸進,並按照醫生建議進行。他正嘗試停止服用安眠藥。；改寫句子時,須保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Something came off means that it actually separated. The button came off my coat. Come off followed by the name of a medicine can mean that somebody stops taking it, often slowly and with medical advice. He is trying to come off sleeping pills. Keep the same people, things, time and meaning when rewriting each sentence.
